title: Arcane mage: Counterspell on a casting mob within 3 s of the cast start

rules.desc: The mage casts Counterspell on the mob within 3 s of an interruptible cast start, at least 60 percent of the time (one trigger per mob per 30 s, one counted answer per 30 s: Counterspell's cooldown)
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/mage/MageStrategy.cpp:428-455 (MageCcStrategy), :443-444 (counterspell at ACTION_INTERRUPT + 1); ai/playerbot/strategy/mage/MageTriggers.h:113; ai/playerbot/strategy/mage/MageActions.h:153-154 (BEGIN_INTERRUPT_SPELL_ACTION); ai/playerbot/AiFactory.cpp:704-721 (mages get 'cc'); ai/playerbot/strategy/generic/ThreatStrategy.cpp:68-83 (the high-threat veto); ai/playerbot/strategy/triggers/GenericTriggers.cpp:1072-1075 (InterruptSpellTrigger); ai/playerbot/PlayerbotAISpells.cpp:1799-1847 (IsInterruptableSpellCasting); ai/playerbot/strategy/actions/GenericSpellActions.h:131-152 (CastInterruptSpellAction / CastMeleeInterruptSpellAction: 'interrupt target', still the CastSpellAction threat type), :39 (ACTION_THREAT_SINGLE); ai/playerbot/strategy/actions/GenericSpellActions.h:501-505 (Shoot is threat type NONE); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: the arcane mage idles while its target attacks the healer, bot ticket T15

rules.desc: Precondition: Defensive Stance (aura 71) stays on the player through the fight
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: setup check player_stance proves the stance at the start, this uptime proves it in the fight
rules.why_expect: the stance is cast in set-up and nothing in the fight removes it; a repeat where it drops shows here instead of passing silently
